items.a: So he can **think his own thoughts** and find his own rhythm.

items.q: What does "buy time, don't sell time" mean?
items.a: **Sell outcomes**, not hours, and pay others for tasks you dislike.

items.q: What is his social media ratio?
items.a: **90% creating, 10% consuming**, with a timer on scrolling.

items.q: Why does he use the sauna daily?
items.a: As **chosen pain**. Handling discomfort others avoid is how you **grow and win**.

items.q: Which habit does he force on himself as an extrovert?
items.a: **Alone time.** Do the opposite of your natural instinct.
The **same bedtime** (about 10:30), a **cold room** and a good bed.
Every no lets you do **your yeses 10x better** and protects your personal brand.
